caption:
You keep checking if you're really forgiven. You stand at the same door asking again and again — but the door was only ever meant to be walked through. (Galatians 4:4-7 devotional)

When the fullness of time came, God sent His Son to pay your price and open the door — not so you'd camp at the threshold, but so you'd walk in as a son. He put the Spirit in your heart crying "Abba, Father," which means you're no longer a slave but an heir. Forgiveness was never the destination; it's the gate into the Father's house.
